description.en: Granny Maggie's cottage, from the door to the cooker: the rooms, the furniture and everything you need at the table.
description.sl: Hišica babice Maggie, od vrat do štedilnika: sobe, pohištvo in vse, kar potrebuješ pri mizi.
description.it: La casetta di nonna Maggie, dalla porta ai fornelli: le stanze, i mobili e tutto quello che serve a tavola.
description.de: Oma Maggies Häuschen, von der Tür bis zum Herd: die Zimmer, die Möbel und alles, was du am Tisch brauchst.

words.example_en: Granny Maggie's house is small and grey.
words.example_sl: Hiša babice Maggie je majhna in siva.
words.example_it: La casa di nonna Maggie è piccola e grigia.
words.example_de: Oma Maggies Haus ist klein und grau.
words.note: A house is the building; home is where you live: I'm going home.
words.note_sl: House je stavba; home je dom: I'm going home (grem domov).
words.note_it: House è l'edificio; home è dove vivi: I'm going home (vado a casa).
words.note_de: House ist das Gebäude; home ist dein Zuhause: I'm going home (ich gehe nach Hause).

words.example_en: Granny Maggie is in the kitchen.
words.example_it: Nonna Maggie è in cucina.
words.example_de: Oma Maggie ist in der Küche.
words.note: Careful: a kitchen is a room, a chicken is a bird!
words.note_sl: Pazi: kitchen je kuhinja, chicken je piščanec!
words.note_it: Attenzione: kitchen è la cucina, chicken è il pollo!
words.note_de: Vorsicht: kitchen ist die Küche, chicken ist das Huhn!

words.example_en: My bedroom is upstairs.
words.example_it: La mia camera da letto è di sopra.
words.example_de: Mein Schlafzimmer ist oben.

words.example_en: The bathroom is next to my bedroom.
words.example_it: Il bagno è accanto alla mia camera.
words.example_de: Das Badezimmer ist neben meinem Schlafzimmer.
words.note: In Britain the toilet is often called the loo.
words.note_sl: Stranišču v Britaniji pogosto rečejo the loo.
words.note_it: In Gran Bretagna il gabinetto si chiama spesso the loo.
words.note_de: Die Toilette heißt in Großbritannien oft the loo.

words.example_en: We sit by the fire in the living room.
words.example_sl: V dnevni sobi sedimo ob ognju.
words.example_it: In soggiorno stiamo seduti accanto al fuoco.
words.example_de: Im Wohnzimmer sitzen wir am Feuer.
words.note: Also called the sitting room or the lounge.
words.note_sl: Rečejo ji tudi sitting room ali lounge.
words.note_it: Si dice anche sitting room o lounge.
words.note_de: Man sagt auch sitting room oder lounge.

words.example_en: Close the door, please. It's cold!
words.example_it: Chiudi la porta, per favore. Fa freddo!
words.example_de: Mach bitte die Tür zu. Es ist kalt!
words.note: One door is singular: the door is open.
words.note_sl: Vrata so v slovenščini množina, door pa ednina: the door is open (vrata so odprta).
words.note_it: Singolare, come la porta: the door is open.
words.note_de: Einzahl, wie die Tür: the door is open.

words.example_en: Look out of the window: it's raining again!
words.example_it: Guarda fuori dalla finestra: piove di nuovo!
words.example_de: Schau aus dem Fenster: Es regnet schon wieder!

words.example_en: The bread is on the table.
words.example_it: Il pane è sul tavolo.
words.example_de: Das Brot ist auf dem Tisch.

words.example_en: Sit on this chair, love.
words.example_it: Siediti su questa sedia, tesoro.
words.example_de: Setz dich auf diesen Stuhl, Schatz.
words.note: Love: in the north of England a kind word for anyone, like dear.
words.note_sl: Love: na severu Anglije prijazen nagovor za vsakogar, kot »srček«.
words.note_it: Love: nel nord dell'Inghilterra un modo affettuoso di chiamare chiunque, come «tesoro».
words.note_de: Love: im Norden Englands eine freundliche Anrede für alle, wie »Schatz«.

words.example_en: I go to bed at nine.
words.example_it: Vado a letto alle nove.
words.example_de: Ich gehe um neun ins Bett.
words.note: Without the: go to bed, in bed.
words.note_sl: Brez the: go to bed (iti spat), in bed (v postelji).
words.note_it: Senza the: go to bed (andare a letto), in bed (a letto).
words.note_de: Ohne the: go to bed (ins Bett gehen), in bed (im Bett).

words.example_en: Poppy runs up the stairs.
words.example_it: Poppy sale le scale di corsa.
words.example_de: Poppy rennt die Treppe hinauf.
words.note: Plural: the stairs. Upstairs is up there, downstairs down there.
words.note_sl: V množini: the stairs. Upstairs je zgoraj, downstairs spodaj.
words.note_it: Al plurale: the stairs. Upstairs è di sopra, downstairs di sotto.
words.note_de: In der Mehrzahl: the stairs. Upstairs ist oben, downstairs unten.

words.example_en: Let's play in the garden!
words.example_it: Giochiamo in giardino!
words.example_de: Lass uns im Garten spielen!
words.note_it: In britannico garden; gli americani dicono yard.

words.example_en: The soup is on the cooker.
words.example_it: La minestra è sui fornelli.
words.example_de: Die Suppe steht auf dem Herd.
words.note: A cooker is what you cook on; a cook is a person. Americans say stove.
words.note_sl: Cooker je štedilnik; cook je kuhar. Američani rečejo stove.
words.note_it: Cooker sono i fornelli; cook è il cuoco. Gli americani dicono stove.
words.note_de: Cooker ist der Herd; cook ist der Koch. Amerikaner sagen stove.

words.example_en: The milk is in the fridge.
words.example_it: Il latte è nel frigorifero.
words.example_de: Die Milch ist im Kühlschrank.

words.example_en: Put the kettle on, love!
words.example_it: Metti su l'acqua per il tè, tesoro!
words.example_de: Setz Teewasser auf, Schatz!
words.note: Put the kettle on: let's make tea! Every British kitchen has a kettle.
words.note_sl: Put the kettle on: skuhajmo čaj! Vsaka britanska kuhinja ima grelnik vode.
words.note_it: Put the kettle on: facciamo un tè! Ogni cucina britannica ha un bollitore.
words.note_de: Put the kettle on: Lass uns Tee machen! Jede britische Küche hat einen Wasserkocher.

words.example_en: Would you like a cup of tea?
words.example_it: Vuoi una tazza di tè?
words.example_de: Möchtest du eine Tasse Tee?
words.note: Always with of: a cup of tea, a glass of milk.
words.note_sl: Vedno z of: a cup of tea, a glass of milk.
words.note_it: Sempre con of: a cup of tea, a glass of milk.
words.note_de: Immer mit of: a cup of tea (nicht a cup tea), a glass of milk.

words.example_en: Granny Maggie cooks tatie pot in a big pot.
words.example_sl: Babica Maggie kuha tatie pot v velikem loncu.
words.example_it: Nonna Maggie cucina il tatie pot in una pentola grande.
words.example_de: Oma Maggie kocht Tatie Pot in einem großen Topf.
words.note: Tatie pot is a Cumbrian stew of lamb and potatoes (a tatie is a potato), named after its pot.
words.note_sl: Tatie pot je cumbrijska enolončnica z jagnjetino in krompirjem (tatie je krompir), imenovana po loncu.
words.note_it: Il tatie pot è uno stufato della Cumbria con agnello e patate (tatie è la patata), che prende il nome dalla pentola.
words.note_de: Tatie Pot ist ein Eintopf aus Cumbria mit Lamm und Kartoffeln (tatie ist die Kartoffel), benannt nach dem Topf.

words.example_en: Your plate is empty! Have some more.
words.example_sl: Tvoj krožnik je prazen! Vzemi si še.
words.example_it: Il tuo piatto è vuoto! Prendine ancora.
words.example_de: Dein Teller ist leer! Nimm dir noch etwas.

words.example_en: A glass of milk, please.
words.example_it: Un bicchiere di latte, per favore.
words.example_de: Ein Glas Milch, bitte.
words.note: Glasses are also what you wear on your nose.

words.example_en: The fork goes on the left.
words.example_it: La forchetta va a sinistra.
words.example_de: Die Gabel liegt links.

words.example_en: You eat porridge with a spoon.
words.example_it: Il porridge si mangia con il cucchiaio.
words.example_de: Haferbrei isst man mit dem Löffel.

words.example_en: Careful, the knife is sharp!
words.example_it: Attento, il coltello è affilato!
words.example_de: Vorsicht, das Messer ist scharf!
words.note: The k is silent. One knife, two knives: f becomes v.
words.note_sl: K se ne izgovori. En nož, dva: knife, knives (f postane v).
words.note_it: La k è muta. Plurale: knives (la f diventa v).
words.note_de: Das k ist stumm. Mehrzahl: knives (aus f wird v).

words.example_en: I lay the table for tea.
words.example_it: Apparecchio la tavola per la cena.
words.example_de: Ich decke den Tisch fürs Abendessen.
words.note: In the north of England, tea is also the evening meal. Americans say set the table.
words.note_sl: Na severu Anglije je tea tudi večerja. Američani rečejo set the table.
words.note_it: Nel nord dell'Inghilterra tea è anche la cena. Gli americani dicono set the table.
words.note_de: Im Norden Englands ist tea auch das Abendessen. Amerikaner sagen set the table.
